skip_reason: The skill fundamentally requires a live, valid Tencent Meeting public share URL and depends on intercepting real-time API responses from Tencent's proprietary cloud infrastructure (meeting.tencent.com). This constitutes an unavoidable dependency on an external stateful/authenticated network service. The script uses Playwright to render real Tencent Meeting web pages and intercept live CDN API calls (`v1/minutes/detail`, `get-full-summary`, `get-chapter`, etc.) — these cannot be deterministically mocked locally without re-implementing Tencent's entire backend. Additionally, the core mechanism involves headless browser rendering of a dynamic web application, which borders on multi-modal browser GUI automation. No isolated, reproducible sandbox environment can be constructed.
